notes.title: Update 2.0! Conclusion.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've released the ending of Marco's chase after Ralph.
It's a lot more fitting compared to the "he's gone" ending we've had.
For now we're putting Test of Courage to the side (unless there's any bugs we need to fix), and 
we're going to focus on our newer games. Thank you to everyone who played our first game and we hope you continue to watch our growth as developers.

notes.title: Update 1.5! Dorms Overhaul: Bobby's Exam.
notes.notes:
Test Of Courage 1.5 Update.

-[New!] Updated Dorms Level: 
    Reworked and completely changed Dorms puzzle. Players currently in [Old] Dorms, will reload into [New} Dorms. Players that have completed the game, can access Chapter Level List [see below for more info] to reload into Dorms and check it out!

-[New!] Added Chapter Level List to Main Menu:
    [Only added once player completes the game once.] Chapter Level List gives the player the option to reload into different chapters to experience the levels again without having to replay through the whole game.

-[New!] Added two possible choices for the ending: These are placeholders while we work on those sometime later.

notes.title: Test of Courage Release Day!
notes.notes:
Release day has arrived. We want to start out by thanking everyone who played our demo.

 One year ago, we went through different ideas that we had for this game. The original setting was going to be in a hospital playing as a father looking for his daughter. We ran into a huge issue 2 months into the development, and had to scrap the project. We restarted the process and decided to change the story and said "what if we created our own universe?."
 We're not sure what to call it yet officially. If we manage to build a community, it would definitely be something I would ask everyone.  Test of Courage is our debut onto the scene and we are proud that we were able to create something and actually finish it. It's not a game that'll cause waves in the horror scene but we hope we're able to integrate ourselves into the community. 
We hope you pass the test and find your friends Ralph and Natalia! 


If there are any bugs or issues please let us know asap.

notes.title: Demo Update: 5
notes.notes:
We finally have a proper entrance to the academy.

The classrooms level was horrible on framerate so we rebuilt it from scratch with a different method. On our end we were getting between 50-80 frames on a 1070 at high setting. With the rebuild we're getting 90+ frames with the same settings. (Let us know if you're getting any consistent frame issues)

Flashlight's impact on performance has been reduced.

Fixed some bugs. If there are any issues with losing control of your mouse(in game) please contact us right away. It appears to be a common issue where certain interactions can cause some funky things to your controls.

notes.title: Game Planned Release and Content update
notes.notes:
Planned Release date: October 2020.

Content Update: 

We're adding A.I to the game. As of now there are two types of A.I. One of them are creatures that patrol a given area, and the other type are hallucinations that only affect your sanity.

There's going to be a a way around the patrolling a.i, you'll be able to jiggle your keys by pressing 'E'. That will bring the creature over to the origin of the sound allowing you to go around them before they go back to patrolling. 

Around the map you will be able to find a ward that will get rid of the hostile creatures on contact. You can set it up as a trap on their patrol path. Or you can just throw it at them (don't miss lol).

Map progression:

We plan on making around 5 main levels that you can explore and find the objects you have to collect. The school will take up 3 of the 5 main levels. 

Story update:

We're making changes or addition to the story as development continues. Once we're happy with the plot we'll release an update to the store page on the game's setting & plot.
